evidence: e2m 8C69 +2 Net_Torque_Fueling_Table_Limit (MM3S, 0.0679, 'net torque fueling limit output from the net torque fueling limit table'): cm848_calculateNetTorqueFuelLimit stores the cm848_interpolateAlphaChiValue blend of the three fuel_demand_table_base_cal engine speed lookups here, then adds the air conditioning clutch / radiator fan friction fuel and clamps it into net_torque_fuel_limit (e2m 8C69 +0); dump 1672 = 113.6 mm3; the old name said governor integral accumulator
comment: e2m 8C69 +2 Net_Torque_Fueling_Table_Limit 'Net Torque fueling limit output from the Net Torque Fueling Limit Table' (MM3S, 0.0679 mm3 per count; 1672 = 113.6 mm3 in the dump): the table value of the net torque fuel limit. cm848_calculateNetTorqueFuelLimit stores here the cm848_interpolateAlphaChiValue blend of the base / chi lower map / chi upper map engine speed lookups of fuel_demand_table_base_cal, then adds friction_fuel_adjustment_for_air_conditioning_clutch and friction_fuel_adjustment_for_radiator_fan (and fuel_demand_offset_correction while fuel_feature_control_flags bit 0x100 is set), clamps the sum to 0..5888 and rate limits it into net_torque_fuel_limit (e2m 8C69 +0 Net_Torque_Fueling_Limit). xref: word (1 write, sth).
